title: The two AI calls inside lecture ingestion (LO extractor + MCQ generator)
purpose: Zoom into the only two places where the lecture pipeline talks to Claude. Show what each call gets as input, what the system prompt is asking Claude to do, what comes back, how we check the response is valid, what we do when Claude messes up, and how the output of the first call feeds the second. The teacher will likely ask 'how do you stop the AI from making bad questions?' — this diagram is the answer.
audience: non-engineer teammates and the grading teacher

groups.label: Claude call #1 — LO extraction (runs once per lecture)
Claude call #2 — MCQ generation (runs once per batch of ≤10 slides)
Shared safety net — retry + validation + failure policies

nodes.label: Factsheet subset (7 keys: surf_extraction_notes, FSLO, narrative_summary, main_topics, important_concepts, skills, exam_relevant_content)
nodes.description: Curated by the orchestrator (D-1.2). Saves ~40% input tokens vs sending the whole factsheet

nodes.label: lo_extractor_system_prompt.md
nodes.description: Tells Claude: read the lecture, identify the learning objectives, give the page range each one covers, AND list pages that should be ignored (title slides, dividers, off-topic asides)

nodes.label: extract_los → call_claude(expect_json=True)
nodes.description: Single Claude API call. The wrapper enables prompt caching so the system prompt only pays full token cost once per 5-minute window

nodes.label: Slide batch (≤10 records of {page_number, raw_md})
nodes.description: Built by the orchestrator from the LO output: only slides inside an LO range and not in ignored_pages get batched

nodes.label: mcq_generator_system_prompt.md
nodes.description: Tells Claude: produce 1–3 MCQs per slide. Hard rules: stems must be self-contained (no 'on this slide' references); ~20% should be multi-correct when content supports it; always 4 options + 4 rationales

nodes.label: generate_mcqs → call_claude(expect_json=True)
nodes.description: One API call per batch — not per slide. Empty mcqs array for a slide means 'not quiz-worthy' (D-4.8)

nodes.label: { by_slide: [{ page_number, mcqs: [{ question, options[4], correct_indices[≥1], rationales_per_option[4], source_page, language }] }] }
_call_with_retry (D-4.4: 2 attempts, no backoff)
nodes.description: Every Claude call goes through this. After 2 failures it gives up and the failure policy below kicks in

nodes.label: _validate_mcq (defensive schema check)
nodes.description: Each MCQ must have exactly 4 options, exactly 4 rationales, and at least one correct_index between 0 and 3. Anything that fails is logged and skipped — the rest of the batch still gets saved

nodes.label: LO call failed twice? → lecture stays 'pending', MCQ stage is SKIPPED entirely (D-4.7)
MCQ batch failed twice? → those slides flip to 'pending', NEXT batch still runs (D-4.5 partial success)
Claude returned empty mcqs for a slide? → slide is reclassified as 'ignored' (D-4.8). NOT an error.

edges.description: The LO output decides which slides become MCQ inputs and which are skipped

Branches per slide when Claude returns mcqs:[]

verification: Both Claude calls are shown as kind=claude_call (LO extractor + MCQ generator)
